title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Divisor the Value of an Unperformed Visit Is Taken On
content:
## Accounts note: the divisor

The divisor the value of an unperformed visit is taken on, under a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record, follows what the term actually credited and what the office actually booked. Two readings decide it: the visits recorded on the term's entitlement credit, and the visits booked on the agreement.

| Reading of the records | The value of the unperformed visit |
|---|---|
| the term's entitlement credit records no visits at all | the annual price in force divided by the visits the tier includes, that is its preventive, inspection and filter change visits together |
| the term's entitlement credit records visits, and the visits booked on the agreement stand above them | the annual price in force divided by the visits booked on the agreement |
| the term's entitlement credit records visits, and the visits booked on the agreement do not stand above them | the annual price in force divided by the visits the term credited |

### Notes

- "Stand above" means strictly greater: where the visits booked equal the visits the term credited, the divisor is the visits the term credited.
- The visits the tier includes, used where the term's entitlement credit records no visits at all, are the tier's preventive visits, inspection visits and filter and belt change visits added together, as published in that tier's visit programme.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- Annual price in force 4 800.00 USD; the term's entitlement credit records 8 visits; 11 visits booked on the agreement. The booked visits stand above the credited visits, so the value is 4 800.00 USD divided by 11, that is 436.36 USD.
- The same agreement with 6 visits booked: the booked visits do not stand above the credited visits, so the value is 4 800.00 USD divided by 8, that is 600.00 USD.
- The same agreement where the term's entitlement credit records no visits at all, at a tier including 4 preventive, 0 inspection and 4 filter and belt change visits: the divisor is 8 and the value is 600.00 USD.
